config_options.description: Controls how Copilot responds: a conversational agent, planning multi-step work, or autonomous autopilot.
config_options.name: Mode

options.description: Default agent mode for conversational interactions
options.name: Agent

options.description: Plan mode for creating and executing multi-step plans
options.name: Plan

options.description: Autonomous mode that enables allow-all and runs until task completion without user interaction (experimental)
options.name: Autopilot

config_options.description: The AI model Copilot uses to generate responses.
config_options.name: Model

config_options.description: How much reasoning the model performs before responding. Higher effort can improve quality at the cost of speed.
config_options.name: Reasoning Effort

options.description: Minimal reasoning before responding.
options.name: low

options.description: Balanced reasoning and speed.
options.name: medium

options.description: More thorough reasoning; slower responses.
options.name: high

options.description: Extensive reasoning for the hardest problems.
options.name: xhigh

options.description: Maximum reasoning; slowest but most thorough.
options.name: max

config_options.description: Controls whether Copilot prompts for approval before using tools, accessing paths, or fetching URLs.
config_options.name: Allow All

options.description: Automatically approve all tool, path, and URL requests
options.name: On

options.description: Require approval for tool, path, and URL requests
options.name: Off
